source.name: KFOR via Yahoo Sports: LIV Golf introduces OKGC as its first U.S. regional franchise
source.note: Names EdgeConneX an OKGC pillar partner; the Edge ConneX logo also sits in the partner grid of the official OKGC team page (livgolf.com/okgc, opened 2026-10-03). The original kfor.com article 403s for scripts, so the Yahoo syndication is cited.
source.quote: OKGC will launch with pillar partnerships from NOBULL and EdgeConnex

source.name: LIV Golf press release: New Era Cap and LIV Golf announce multi-year partnership
source.note: League-wide deal: New Era Cap is Official Cap of the LIV Golf League and its products are worn by LIV Golf players of every team, including OKGC; the New Era logo sits in the OKGC team page partner grid (livgolf.com/okgc, opened 2026-10-03). The page shows only a relative date ('29 months ago', read 2026-10-03); the partnership was announced and covered in April 2024.
source.quote: announced a multi-year partnership in which New Era Cap will become the Official Cap of the LIV Golf League

summary: Team partners 2026: EdgeConneX, No Bull, New Era. Led by Talor Gooch. Renamed from Smash GC for 2026.
